title: Storage & Lakehouse Architecture
description: A focused, compact intermediate path on the storage-layer decisions that define a modern data platform: data lake vs data warehouse trade-offs, lakehouse ACID guarantees, and file-format selection for columnar access.
outcomes: You'll articulate when a lakehouse beats a pure data lake or warehouse, reason about ACID concurrency guarantees at the storage layer, and choose file formats for downstream columnar query patterns.
